title: IPv6-in-IPv6: decapsulated inner datagram is not re-surveyed for RH3
description: Codereview finding (P2, security-adjacent) from ba39 3-pass review. rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:296-300 and 352-355 deliver a decapsulated inner datagram without running survey_routing_headers on it; secure.rs:1935-1979 will parse an RH3 present in a delivered datagram without the survey's grid constraints and without rejecting in-transit segments_left. Bounded: local dispatch requires UDP, OSCORE context keys on link-authenticated sender IID, C router rejects NH=41 outright (router.c:375-377) so it is a Rust-only divergence. Suggested hardening: reject next_header==43 (or re-survey) on the delivered inner at both decap sites. Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-ba39
